set.body:
Outcome: the historical video runner and StageTrace consume one originating LocalEvidence through a bench-private executed-run owner, preserving the frozen historical parity result and genuine registered ONNX origin.
Scope/non-goals: StageTrace/RecallToVideo, runtime and external compile courts, ADR0019 and evidence. No new module/dependency/public Scala API, public reference/reconstruction facade, learned/corpus/private-data run or efficacy claim.
Invariants: no fromParts(evidence,result,config) producer; actual GraphHsmm evidence overload mints final non-case run with exact immutable evidence/config/result. Historical producer computes evidence once; registered producer derives inputs/evidence exclusively from Registered and retains original records/basis. Generic strict provenance is not ONNX execution. Trace reads original nominations/provenance/base costs, config identity and complete published cost/support/reduction/imputation/exclusion records. Refined traces visibly refuse; ordinary refined inference remains available. Downstream scene choices remain reported diagnostics. No source/participant prose, new private payload/vector hashes or scorer invocation during rendering.
Relevant paths: StageTrace.scala, RecallToVideo.scala, StageTraceSuite/OriginSuite, external StageTraceBoundarySuite, HistoricalEmbeddingParityCapture; existing LocalEvidence, GraphHsmm, Registered, HsmmResultCodec.
Proposed change: private executed-run factory with historical, existing-evidence and registered paths; trace v2 uses it and retains complete originating receipts. Actual runner and parity capture use historical producer; rendering consumes run without replaceable result/config/evidence. Preserve primary report, defaults and golden body/digest.
Acceptance evidence: counterexample shows one-unit identical results under distinct transition configs; competing multi-unit fixture kills config substitution; counted pricing and closed-encoder controls prove no re-pricing; equal results with different provenance/receipts remain distinct; all-unranked failure/tie/uniform outcomes survive; positive refinement passes refuse even at zero weight; binding/order/ref validation; outside-defining-package constructor/copy/product/Mirror/read doors each have positive controls. Compiled named mutations, exact restored scoped JVM/JS/Native gate where built, format last, exact-SHA independent review and narrow publication.
Risks/escalation: result consistency does not prove execution; preserve separate engine and provider identities and keyed/withheld receipts. Existing full-media serializer limitations stay explicit. G1 residual acceptance remains on parent. Red main CI preempts this slice.
Next action: reserve, implement decided private seam, compile and commit narrow source, then falsify and qualify.
set.title: [G1/S2b-5] Adopt originating local evidence in executed StageTrace runs
